name: WotLK
note: What this expansion ADDED, from tools/spell-ids/wotlk.json. Spells carried over from earlier expansions are not repeated here.

Death Knight.name: Blood Presence
Death Knight.desc: Strengthens the Death Knight with the presence of blood, increasing damage by 15% and healing the Death Knight by 4% of non-periodic damage dealt. Only one Presence may be active at a time.

Death Knight.name: Blood Strike
Death Knight.desc: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 40% weapon damage plus 104, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

Death Knight.name: Death Coil
Death Knight.desc: Fire a blast of unholy energy, causing 167 Shadow damage to an enemy target or healing 250.5 damage from a friendly Undead target Glyph of Death's Embrace Refunds 20 runic power when used to heal .

Death Knight.name: Death Grip
Death Knight.desc: Harness the unholy energy that surrounds and binds all matter, drawing the target toward the death knight and forcing the enemy to attack the death knight for 3 sec.

Death Knight.name: Icy Touch
Death Knight.desc: Chills the target for 127 to 137 Frost damage and infects them with Frost Fever, a disease that deals periodic damage and reduces melee and ranged attack speed by 14% for 15 sec. Very high threat when in Frost Presence.

Death Knight.name: Plague Strike
Death Knight.desc: A vicious strike that deals 50% weapon damage plus 62.5 and infects the target with Blood Plague, a disease dealing Shadow damage over time.

Death Knight.name: Death Strike
Death Knight.desc: A deadly attack that deals 75% weapon damage plus 84 and heals the Death Knight for 5% of his maximum health for each of his diseases on the target.

Death Knight.name: Pestilence
Death Knight.desc: Spreads existing Blood Plague and Frost Fever infections from your target to all other enemies within 10 yards.

Death Knight.name: Raise Dead
Death Knight.desc: Raises a Ghoul to fight by your side. If no humanoid corpse that yields experience or honor is available, you must supply Corpse Dust to complete the spell. You can have a maximum of one Ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.

Death Knight.name: Frost Presence
Death Knight.desc: The death knight takes on the presence of frost, increasing Stamina by 8%, armor contribution from cloth, leather, mail and plate items by 60%, and reducing damage taken by 8%. Increases threat generated. Only one Presence may be active at a time.

Death Knight.name: Mind Freeze
Death Knight.desc: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

Death Knight.name: Blood Boil
Death Knight.desc: Boils the blood of all enemies within 10 yards, dealing 89 to 107 Shadow damage. Deals additional damage to targets infected with Blood Plague or Frost Fever.

Death Knight.name: Death and Decay
Death Knight.desc: Corrupts the ground targeted by the Death Knight, causing 26 Shadow damage every sec that targets remain in the area for 10 sec. This ability produces a high amount of threat.

Death Knight.name: Obliterate
Death Knight.desc: A brutal instant attack that deals 80% weapon damage plus 198, total damage increased 12.5% per each of your diseases on the target, but consumes the diseases.

Death Knight.name: Horn of Winter
Death Knight.desc: The Death Knight blows the Horn of Winter, which generates 10 runic power and increases total Strength and Agility of all party or raid members within 30 yards by 86. Lasts 2 min.

Death Knight.name: Rune Strike
Death Knight.desc: Strike the target for 150% weapon damage plus (150 * Attack power * 10 / 10000). Only usable after the Death Knight dodges or parries. Can't be dodged, blocked, or parried. This attack causes a high amount of threat.

Death Knight.name: Anti-Magic Shell
Death Knight.desc: Surrounds the Death Knight in an Anti-Magic Shell, absorbing 75% of the damage dealt by harmful spells (up to a maximum of 50% of the Death Knight's health) and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed by Anti-Magic Shell energizes the Death Knight with additional runic power. Lasts 5 sec.

Death Knight.name: Unholy Presence
Death Knight.desc: Infuses the death knight with unholy fury, increasing attack speed by 15%, movement speed by 15% and reducing the global cooldown on all abilities by 0.5 sec. Only one Presence may be active at a time.

Death Knight.name: Army of the Dead
Death Knight.desc: Summons an entire legion of Ghouls to fight for the Death Knight. The Ghouls will swarm the area, taunting and fighting anything they can. While channelling Army of the Dead, the Death Knight takes less damage equal to his Dodge plus Parry chance.

Warrior.name: Shattering Throw
Warrior.desc: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing (12 + Attack power * .50) damage (based on attack power), reducing the armor on the target by 20% for 10 sec or removing any invulnerabilities.

Warrior.name: Enraged Regeneration
Warrior.desc: You regenerate 30% of your total health over 10 sec. This ability requires an Enrage effect, consumes all Enrage effects and prevents any from affecting you for the full duration.

Warrior.name: Heroic Throw
Warrior.desc: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing (12 + Attack power * .50) damage (based on attack power). This ability causes high threat.

Paladin.name: Hand of Reckoning
Paladin.desc: Taunts the target to attack you. If the target is tauntable and not currently targeting you, causes (1 + 0.5 * Attack power) Holy damage.

Paladin.name: Divine Plea
Paladin.desc: You gain 25% of your total mana over 15 sec, but the amount healed by your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Holy Shock spells is reduced by 50%.

Paladin.name: Shield of Righteousness
Paladin.desc: Slam the target with your shield, causing Holy damage based on your block value plus an additional 390.

Hunter.name: Kill Shot
Hunter.desc: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a long range attack dealing 200% weapon damage plus (Ranged attack power * 0.40 + 205 * 2). Kill Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Hunter.name: Aspect of the Dragonhawk
Hunter.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a dragonhawk, increasing ranged attack power by 230 and chance to dodge by 18%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Hunter.name: Master's Call
Hunter.desc: Your pet attempts to remove all root and movement impairing effects from itself and its target, and causes your pet and its target to be immune to all such effects for 4 sec.

Hunter.name: Call Stabled Pet
Hunter.desc: Choose one of your stabled pets to replace your current pet. The selected pet busts out of its stable to join you no matter where you are. Cannot be used in combat.

Rogue.name: Dismantle
Rogue.desc: Disarm the enemy, removing all weapons, shield or other equipment carried for 10 sec.

Rogue.name: Tricks of the Trade
Rogue.desc: The current party or raid member becomes the target of your Tricks of the Trade. The threat caused by your next damaging attack and all actions taken for 6 sec afterwards will be transferred to the target. In addition, all damage caused by the target is increased by 15% during this time.

Rogue.name: Fan of Knives
Rogue.desc: Instantly throw both weapons at all targets within 8 yards, causing 105% weapon damage with daggers, and 70% weapon damage with all other weapons.

Priest.name: Mind Sear
Priest.desc: Causes an explosion of shadow magic around the enemy target, causing 183 to 197 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to all enemies within 10 yards around the target.

Priest.name: Divine Hymn
Priest.desc: Heals 3 nearby lowest health friendly party or raid targets within 40 yards for 3024 to 3342 every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases healing done to them by 10% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 heals. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Priest.name: Hymn of Hope
Priest.desc: Restores 3% mana to 3 nearby low mana friendly party or raid targets every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases their total maximum mana by 20% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 mana restores. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Shaman.name: Lava Burst
Shaman.desc: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 1038 to 1316 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst will deal a critical strike.

Shaman.name: Hex
Shaman.desc: Transforms the enemy into a frog. While hexed, the target cannot attack or cast spells. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Lasts 30 sec. Only one target can be hexed at a time. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

Mage.name: Frostfire Bolt
Mage.desc: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing [629 * ((((1))) * (1))] to [731 * ((((1))) * (1))] Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 60 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists.

Mage.name: Mirror Image
Mage.desc: Creates 3 copies of the caster nearby, which cast spells and attack the mage's enemies. Lasts 30 sec.

Warlock.name: Demonic Circle: Summon
Warlock.desc: You summon a Demonic Circle at your feet, lasting 6 min. You can only have one Demonic Circle active at a time.

Warlock.name: Demonic Circle: Teleport
Warlock.desc: Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all snare effects.

Druid.name: Revive
Druid.desc: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 65 health and 120 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

Druid.name: Nourish
Druid.desc: Heals a friendly target for 1883 to 2187. Heals for an additional 20% if you have a Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom, or Wild Growth effect active on the target.
